details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook that runs beacon.cjs, and index.js also invokes the same beacon when the module is required. The beacon sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with a JSON body containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the current working directory and an npm/node version string, tagged with an x-beacon-package header. It collects and transmits no credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents, and performs no other action; the module otherwise exports a no-op Proxy so imports of the name do not fail.
